page.title: Backtesting Control Room
page.intro: One page for the whole evidence path: what a morning is read from, which frozen rules decide it, which workflows run it, what scores it, and what the published evidence still does not claim. Every state below is read from a published artefact when this page opens, so no state is typed in by hand and none can drift away from the file it came from.
page.note: Research only. Nothing here is published as a live call, sizes a position or places a trade, and no figure on this page is an edge claim.

legend.label: Complete
legend.meaning: The artefact records this step as done, and the check that belongs to it has run.

legend.label: Pending
legend.meaning: Built and running, but something the artefact names is still outstanding.

legend.label: Blocked
legend.meaning: A named input is missing, so the step stops there. Nothing is filled in or estimated.

legend.label: Stale
legend.meaning: Computed on an older build of the panel than the one now published.

legend.label: Unknown
legend.meaning: No artefact in this checkout states it, so the page says so instead of guessing.

legend.label: Inactive
legend.meaning: Present and deployed, but deliberately not running or not counted.

bands.label: Inputs
bands.caption: What a morning is read from, and whether each value could have been known at 05:00 London.

bands.label: Decision
bands.caption: The registry, the frozen rules and the Cloud pair that turn a saved morning into a call.

bands.label: Measurement
bands.caption: What the call is scored against, and what reproduces when the engine is run again.

bands.label: Proof
bands.caption: What the published evidence claims, claim by claim, and what it leaves open.

nodes.title: Source retrieval
nodes.role: Where every morning value comes from
nodes.summary: Each key a model consumes is resolved through a declared source catalogue: provider, series, transform and publication lag. A value counts as contemporaneous only when a capture taken at or before the cutoff matches it and carries a receipt; otherwise it is labelled a reconstruction, with a digest and no receipt.

out: One resolved value per key, with a receipt or a reconstruction digest

software.note: The resolver, the source clock policy and the receipt test are in place, and they report what they found instead of assuming it.

data.note: {{retrieval.capture_corpus.entries|count}} captures are held, so every value in the panel is a reconstruction rather than something captured before the cutoff.

research.note: Historical availability is the claim this step exists to support, and the evidence records it as not established.

nodes.title: Saved morning panel
nodes.role: The one committed panel every call is replayed against
nodes.summary: One research artefact holds a row per London morning: the values, the frozen calls and the outcomes. The Cloud children read this panel and never fetch history themselves, so a replay on its own never shows a value was available at the cutoff.

in: Resolved values for every declared key
out: One row per eligible morning, each stamped against the 05:00 London cutoff

software.note: The panel builds, carries its cutoff contract, and is the dataset every artefact below names.

data.note: The sweep covers {{coverage.panel_mornings|count}} of the {{evidence.source_dataset.sessions|count}} panel mornings, with {{evidence.source_dataset.cutoff_contract.cutoff_local}} {{evidence.source_dataset.cutoff_contract.cutoff_zone}} as the cutoff.

research.note: The panel is a research artefact: nothing shows it equals what a live 05:00 run would have offered on each date.

nodes.title: Model registry
nodes.role: Which models exist, and which of them are research
nodes.summary: One registry lists the production baseline, the two frozen challengers and one fixture. The Cloud children are generated from it, so a newly registered model needs no hand edit of a workflow and cannot quietly become a different model.

in: Registered model definitions and their source files
out: One generated Cloud adapter per registered model, carrying its identity

software.note: Every registered model has a workflow identity, a source file and a published URL.

data.note: The runtime bundle is versioned ({{evidence.bundle.bundle_version}}) and built from the registry's own modules.

research.note: The production baseline is registered but deliberately not invoked in the Cloud pair; only the two frozen challengers and the fixture are.

nodes.title: Frozen rulebook
nodes.role: The rules a morning is decided by
nodes.summary: The rule set is versioned and frozen on a named date, so a call can be traced to the exact rows that produced it. Some rows vote, some are counted elsewhere, some act as a gate and some are excluded; the book says which is which.

in: The frozen decision version and its eligibility rules
out: One directional call per eligible morning, or an abstention with a reason

software.note: The version, the freeze date and the vote specification are recorded together, so a call names the rules behind it.

data.note: The published counts were computed on a panel built {{rules.scored.current.run_generated_at|datetime}}; the panel served today was rebuilt {{evidence.source_dataset.generated_at|datetime}}.

research.note: Frozen and experimental: a written specification exists and the implementation is checked against it, but the rules themselves are not independently adjudicated.

nodes.title: Paired controller
nodes.role: The n8n Cloud parent that runs one morning through the pair
nodes.summary: A manual or header-authenticated webhook fetches the published panel, selects one morning and calls each child once, then reports the matrix it executed. It has no schedule, and the webhook was deactivated as soon as the evidence run finished.

out: One call per child, with the execution ids that produced it

software.note: The parent is deployed, and every node and code blob was read back and compared with the committed files after the write.

data.note: Recorded Cloud executions exist for {{evidence.execution_cases.length|count}} controlled mornings, and the run ledger re-verifies each of them.

research.note: Deliberately not running: manual and webhook only, no schedule, and the webhook is off until another run is asked for.

nodes.title: Challenger v0
nodes.summary: A frozen challenger that reads the saved panel and returns one call or an abstention. The Cloud adapter evaluates the model's own rules on the stored values and never reads a stored prediction, its arithmetic is recomputed against the committed outcomes, and the fresh-call proof shows the call changes when an input changes.

in: One panel row: the values the model consumes
out: A direction or an abstention, with its conviction and reasons

software.note: Deployed and active. It carries an execute-workflow trigger only, so it cannot start itself.

data.note: {{coverage.by_model.challenger.panel_coverage_pct|count}}% of the panel carries a stored call, over {{coverage.by_model.challenger.unique_dates|count}} mornings.

research.note: The child recomputes the call from the saved inputs - 8 of 8 rehearsal cases and a captured execution - but a call that reproduces perfectly is still not proof that the rules are right.

nodes.title: Challenger v1
nodes.role: Frozen research model, the London pit-conditional build
nodes.summary: The second frozen challenger, checked against a second hand transcription of its approved specification as well as against deliberately corrupted inputs and calculations. Like v0 it replays the saved panel and cannot start itself.

in: One panel row: the values this model consumes
out: A direction or an abstention, with its conviction and reasons

software.note: Deployed and active, with an execute-workflow trigger only.

data.note: The specification check passes: {{spec.hand_examples.passed|count}} hand examples, {{spec.corrupted_calls.detected|count}} corrupted calls, {{spec.corrupted_tables.detected|count}} corrupted tables and {{spec.corrupted_inputs.detected|count}} corrupted input sets were all caught.

research.note: The child recomputes its call and the specification check holds it to the written rules; neither shows that the rules are right.

nodes.title: Constant fixture
nodes.role: A test double in the same pair
nodes.summary: A registered constant answer that proves an arbitrary model set runs through the same pair. It is labelled a fixture in every artefact it touches, its calls are never pooled with a book, and no performance figure may include it.

out: The same answer every morning, by design

software.note: Deployed and active, so the plumbing is proven with a model that cannot be mistaken for research.

data.note: {{coverage.by_model.fixture_constant.records|count}} recorded call, held apart from every research count.

research.note: Never counted: a fixture cannot support a research claim, so its research state stays inactive by design.

nodes.title: Outcome scoring
nodes.role: Every call scored against the window it names
nodes.summary: The panel declares its markets and its tests, and a run scores the matrix its own dataset names rather than a hard-coded list. Direction is measured today; the two level simulations are built and checked, but wait on a tape and a ladder that history does not hold.

out: Hit, miss, flat and no-outcome counts per market and test

software.note: {{matrix.markets.length|count}} markets and {{matrix.tests.length|count}} tests are declared in configuration, and each run reports the matrix it executed.

data.note: The published matrix scores {{readiness.published.counts.scored|count}} cells, prices {{readiness.published.counts.proxy_scored|count}} on a named proxy, measures {{readiness.published.counts.measured_tick_replay|count}} by tick replay and blocks {{readiness.published.counts.blocked|count}}; every blocked cell names its own missing dataset. The five-minute archive carries bid and ask for {{m5.coverage.instruments_with_bid_ask|count}} of {{m5.coverage.instruments_required|count}} instruments.

research.note: {{readiness.advantage.status}} - no published cell establishes a predictive advantage.

nodes.claims_title: What is published, what waits, and what is not claimed
limitations: The scratch run that read 7 scored, 1 proxy-scored, 8 measured and 8 blocked is unpublished research evidence, not live readiness.
No cell in the published matrix establishes a predictive advantage; the counts record what could be measured, not accuracy or edge.

nodes.title: Reproduction and parity
nodes.role: Does the stored call reproduce, to the number?
nodes.summary: A local controller re-runs every model over the panel and compares both the call and the arithmetic with what was stored. A second check runs the generated Cloud bundle against that controller, so a change in the bundle cannot pass unnoticed.

out: Match and mismatch counts per model, per window

software.note: The parity gate is built into the publish path, so a mismatch fails the run rather than being reported quietly.

data.note: {{parity.decision_matches|count}} of {{parity.checked|count}} decisions and {{parity.result_matches|count}} of {{parity.results_checked|count}} results reproduce, with {{parity.decision_mismatches|count}} decision mismatches.

research.note: Reproduction is not accuracy: a stored call that repeats perfectly can still be wrong, and this check never claims otherwise.

nodes.title: Fresh-call proof
nodes.role: Does the Cloud child compute the call, or repeat the stored row?
nodes.summary: The child is sent one morning's cutoff inputs and a model name with the stored calls and results removed. Re-running the committed parent glue and child wrapper over eight cases reproduces 8 of 8 calls and 4 of 4 per-market results, and negating one saved input at a time moves the call in 27 of 110 probes. One real Cloud execution (parent 7260, children 7261 and 7262) returned the same call. This establishes call generation only: it does not establish contemporaneous availability across the 725 mornings, and it is not accuracy or edge.

in: One morning's cutoff inputs, a model name and a validation label
The committed parent glue and the pinned Cloud bundle
out: The direction, conviction, eligibility and per-market results, recomputed in the child

software.note: The rehearsal reproduces the published call from stripped inputs and the captured execution agrees with the rehearsal; the verdict's blocking list holds {{freshcall.verdict.blocking|count}} entries.

data.note: {{freshcall.totals.calls_matching_published|count}} of {{freshcall.totals.cases|count}} calls and {{freshcall.totals.scoring_cases_matching|count}} scored cases match, from {{freshcall.totals.input_probes|count}} single-input probes.

research.note: Call generation is established; the rules that produce the call are still not independently adjudicated, and one captured morning is not a sample.

tests.title: Rehearsal: committed parent glue and child wrapper, stored calls and results stripped
tests.note: {{freshcall.totals.calls_matching_published}} of {{freshcall.totals.cases}} calls and {{freshcall.totals.scoring_cases_matching}} of 4 scored cases agree; {{freshcall.totals.probes_that_moved_the_call}} of {{freshcall.totals.input_probes}} probes move the call.

tests.title: Live: one Cloud execution, captured and deactivated after the call
tests.note: Parent {{freshcall.live_call.execution.id}}, children {{freshcall.live_call.child_executions.0.execution_id}} and {{freshcall.live_call.child_executions.1.execution_id}}; agrees with the recomputation.

limitations: One execution is one morning. It is kept because it is inspectable, not because it is a sample.
The fresh-call proof does not establish contemporaneous availability: the saved inputs are still not shown to have been known before the 05:00 cutoff on any of the 725 mornings.
No accuracy, hit rate, edge or predictive advantage is claimed.

nodes.title: Published evidence
nodes.role: What the evidence claims, and what it refuses to claim
nodes.summary: Five claims are published side by side instead of one headline. Internal consistency and call generation are established; historical availability, model logic and coverage are not established, and this page repeats that rather than smoothing it into a single score.

out: One evidence file, one run ledger and the pages that read them

software.note: The evidence file is generated by a script rather than written by hand, and this page reads it live when it opens.

data.note: The ledger re-verifies from its own raw captures: {{evidence.sweep.summary.records|count}} rows over {{evidence.sweep.summary.unique_dates|count}} mornings.

research.note: Two of the five claims are established - internal consistency and call generation - and three are recorded as not established.

claims.label: Call generation
claims.note: Established for eight rehearsal cases and one captured execution (7260): the child recomputes the call from stripped inputs. It is not a survey and not an edge.
